# Spaceson Labs

> Spaceson Labs is an AI-native product studio. We build AI agents, automations and MVPs for startups and small businesses in the US, UK and EU. Fixed scope, fixed price, a working demo every week. Remote, EU and US hours.

## Packages and prices (USD)

- AI Agent & Automation: from $2,500, setup + from $750/mo retainer. Live in 1–2 weeks. An agent that does real work inside the tools your team already uses. Covers: Discovery: a short audit of the process you want to automate; The build: 2–4 workflows plus the AI agent, wired into your tools; Monitoring and alerts set up; 30 days of tuning after go-live; Retainer from $750/mo: monitoring, new workflows, fixes. Model usage billed at cost.
- MVP in 3 Weeks: from $6,000, fixed scope, fixed price. 3 weeks. A product real users can sign up for and pay in, not a clickable mockup. Covers: A one-page plan with scope, timeline and one price before we start; Sign-in, billing, admin panel, landing page and analytics; A working build every week; Two rounds of changes; Code and IP handed over after final payment.
- Product Engineering on Demand: from $5,500/mo, monthly, scale up or down. Start within a week. Senior frontend and full-stack capacity that plugs into your own team. Covers: A senior engineer's time, billed monthly; Planning, standups and code review with your team; Scale up or down month to month; No hiring, no long contract.

Also: Telegram bots & Mini Apps, Web3/TON.

Email hello@spacesonlabs.com with a few lines about what you want built. You get a one-page plan with scope, timeline and one price within 24 hours.
